expanded_tasks.title: Exhaustive coverageReport lever counts without take(500) truncation
expanded_tasks.agent_rationale: coverageReport live-branch lever counting, curated_routes hygiene (test:/seed: purge or exclusion), and any aggregate/pagination helpers are Convex-backend only. No RN UI. Primary proof is integration against real Convex with N>500 status buckets so a remaining take(500) cannot green.

boundary_contracts: coverageReport lever candidateCount/passCount and terminalStates/provenanceCounts for the unscoped live path must equal exhaustive catalog membership for counted rows (minus excluded test:/seed: contamination), never a silently truncated .take(N) sample

A status bucket with >500 rows must still yield candidateCount == full seeded provenance membership for that provenance; minority provenances buried after 500 majority rows must not report candidateCount: 0
test:/seed: contamination must not inflate or deflate production lever/terminal counts on the unscoped founder path; prefix-scoped harness isolation remains intact
Founder-Operator accept/reject (UC-REC-04 AC-7) must not use a pre-fix truncated coverageReport; post-fix report is the only valid live input for realized-yield comparison

must: MUST make lever-candidate counting exhaustive for the live coverageReport path: either (A) paginate each geometryStatus (and provenance membership) to completion with real Convex .paginate() multi-call orchestration (no fixed row cap on the final count), or (B) maintain an indexed aggregate/counter table keyed by geometryProvenance (and optionally geometryStatus) updated on write so coverageReport never depends on a truncated row scan

MUST prove exhaustiveness with integration seeds where a single geometryStatus bucket has N>500 rows and minority provenances (ai_reconstructed, name_routed) appear only after the first 500 majority rows — candidateCount for those provenances must equal the seeded truth, not 0 and not a take(500) partial

MUST purge OR exclude routeIds matching isTestSeedRoute (test:/seed: and shared markers) from unscoped live coverageReport lever/terminal/provenance counts so the ~202 contamination rows cannot crowd real rows or pollute candidateCount / riderReadyCount
MUST preserve prefix-scoped / routeIds-scoped harness isolation: when routeIdPrefix starts with test: (or explicit idSet of test routes), test rows remain countable for integration harnesses

MUST re-run or prove via real-Convex integration that a fresh post-fix coverageReport is trustworthy before any Founder accept/reject; document operator step for live pnpm tsx scripts/backfill-curated-geometry.ts --all when full catalog rebatch is required outside CI

MUST respect Convex hard rules: exactly one .paginate() per function; stay under 16MB read budget — if full exhaustive per-row geometry joins exceed limits, prefer aggregate counters or multi-invocation accumulation without silent truncation
MUST define returns validators on any new public/internal functions and use v.id / schema-aligned validators
never: NEVER leave .take(500) (or any silent fixed take(N) cap) as the final source of lever candidateCount / terminalStates / provenanceCounts on the unscoped live coverageReport path at convex/curatedGeometry.ts ~1330-1360
NEVER claim candidateCount from a truncated scan; a false zero (candidateCount: 0) for real ai_reconstructed / name_routed rows is a hard fail
NEVER leave test:/seed: rows counting as production levers on the unscoped path without exclusion or table purge
NEVER use the pre-fix truncated coverageReport for Founder-Operator accept/reject or expected-yield comparison
NEVER mock ctx.db / query results as primary proof; unit-only stubs of lever counts are invalid for behavioral ACs
NEVER weaken validate_scenario (must_observe must stay concrete; negative_control must fail take(500)/hardcoded zeros/static reports)
strictly: STRICTLY a stub that returns hardcoded lever counts, a still-present take(500) on the live path, or counts that only work for ≤500-row buckets MUST fail the REDHATFIX07 integration suite
STRICTLY primary ACs are integration against Convex dev deployment with seed_method public_api (real seed mutations / test support) — never view injection

STRICTLY if strategy B (aggregates) is chosen, counters must stay consistent under write (insert/patch geometryStatus/geometryProvenance/riderReady) and coverageReport must read aggregates, not a truncated scan fallback that can diverge
STRICTLY CAP-GEO-04 boundary: all-levers-failed / low-yield founder decisions depend on honest lever candidateCounts — truncated zeros falsify escalation and rejection

specification.objective: Fix coverageReport live-branch per-status scans so lever candidate/pass counts and terminal/provenance tallies are exhaustive (no silent take(500) truncation), and purge or exclude residual test:/seed: contamination from unscoped production counts so Founder batch acceptance uses a trustworthy realized-yield packet.
specification.success_state: Unscoped live coverageReport returns lever candidateCounts equal to full catalog membership for each geometryProvenance (minus excluded test:/seed:); a status bucket with N>500 no longer undercounts minority levers to 0; take(500) is gone from the live counting path; integration RED→GREEN proves N>500 and contamination hygiene; operator may re-run --all and obtain a fresh non-truncated report before accept/reject.
specification.background: Post-remediation orchestrator finding 2026-07-25T03:35Z: live coverageReport (no runId / non-persisted path) at convex/curatedGeometry.ts:1330-1360 loops geometryStatus in [generated, review, unresolved, failed] with .withIndex('by_geometry_status').take(500). Live catalog had ~5959 total rows (~2930 generated, ~2893 unresolved, both >>500). Minority provenances ai_reconstructed (71 real) and name_routed (11 real) fell outside the first 500 rows of their status bucket → candidateCount: 0 false zeros → rejected batch-acceptance decision on a possibly-valid catalog. REDHAT-FIX-03 only scrubbed listRetirementCandidates export, not the table and not coverageReport scans; ~202 test:/seed: rows still resident in curated_routes can crowd real rows out of any bounded scan.

interaction_notes: No RN UI. Operator + founder consume coverageReport / acceptance packet only.

Convex allows exactly ONE .paginate() per function — exhaustive multi-status counts cannot loop paginate inside a single query. Prefer either: (A) multi-invocation accumulate (internalQuery page + action/mutation loop, or cursor-encoded resume until isDone with no silent drop of unread pages), or (B) write-time aggregate counters keyed by geometryProvenance (+ optional geometryStatus).

Per-row curated_route_geometry joins for passCount on ~6k rows risk 16MB read limits — if strategy A retains per-row joins, accumulate across pages; if limits bind, store pass/verdict fields used for counting on route or aggregates.
Unscoped path: exclude isTestSeedRoute OR purge contamination from table. Prefix/idSet path: keep test rows for harness isolation (parity with FIX-03 AC-2).
Do not break REDHAT-FIX-01: live path still must not claim completed full-batch isDone/totalCostUSD stubs.
design.pattern: Primary recommended: replace live-path .take(500) with exhaustive counting. Strategy A — multi-call .paginate() orchestration to completion (existing listForGeometryBackfill / listAllRoutesForReset continueCursor/isDone loops; optional cursor-encoded multi-status walk like listRetirementCandidates but without a fixed final cap that drops unread pages). Strategy B — indexed aggregate/counter table updated on geometryStatus/geometryProvenance/riderReady writes; coverageReport reads aggregates. Either way ACs prove N>500 and minority-buried correctness. Reuse isTestSeedRoute for unscoped exclusion or add purge mutation for residual test:/seed: rows.

design.anti_pattern: .take(500) per geometryStatus as a complete catalog scan for lever candidateCount; treating candidateCount:0 as real when minority provenances exist past the first 500 rows; counting test:/seed: as production levers on the unscoped founder path; Founder accept/reject on a pre-fix truncated coverageReport
